three_independent_blockers.name: boundary cue is vendor-specific
three_independent_blockers.detail: qa_reconstruction._qualifying_boundaries admits an Operator segment only when its text contains the literal 'go ahead'. In this transcript exactly one of twelve Operator segments carries that cue, and it is segment 0 — the pre-presentation IR handoff ('...hand the conference over to your speaker today, Jim Friedland, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead.'), which is not a Q&A boundary. All nine real analyst question intros close with 'Your line is now open.' instead. The generic detector therefore returns exactly one boundary and it is a false positive.

three_independent_blockers.name: no management role is published by this vendor
three_independent_blockers.detail: The segment role vocabulary in this body is exactly {'Operator', 'IR', ''}: 12 Operator, 3 IR, 75 empty. Every management turn — Sundar Pichai (30), Philipp Schindler (14), Anat Ashkenazi (17) — carries role ''. qa_reconstruction._is_management returns bool(role), so roleless management speech cannot be classified as management and is rejected as an unexpected speaker. AAPL's held body by contrast publishes explicit CEO/CFO roles (IR 10 / CEO 42 / CFO 23 / Operator 8 / empty 25). This blocker is independent of B1: a white-box probe of the unchanged _reconstruct_exchange over the real boundary window [33,40) fails with 'unexpected_non_housekeeping_speaker: segment 35 speaker Sundar Pichai is not the verified questioner'. The committed regression proves the same law with a public-API minimal pair in which the management role is the only variable.

three_independent_blockers.name: qa_exchange.v1 cannot mint a source-supported roleless respondent
three_independent_blockers.detail: Even had B1 and B2 been resolved, qa_exchange._assert_respondent_identity requires a non-empty source role on every respondent and raises WorkspaceError('respondent name and role must be source-supported'). With this body's roleless management speech, no respondent could be minted source-supported without fabricating a role — which the freeze forbids. This blocker sits downstream of reconstruction entirely.

secondary_observation.name: operator identity grammar partially generalizes
secondary_observation.detail: qa_reconstruction._NAME_CUE_RE does correctly extract the analyst name from this vendor's phrasing ('Our next question comes from Brian Nowak with Morgan Stanley' -> name 'Brian Nowak'). The affiliation parse over-captures: _AFFIL_CUT_RE truncates only at a go-ahead clause, '?', '!' or end-of-string, so with no go-ahead clause present the affiliation becomes 'Morgan Stanley. Your line is now open.' rather than 'Morgan Stanley'. Recorded as evidence about the grammar's AAPL shape. NOT repaired in this wave — repairing it here would be tuning the compiler on the E3-C event.
